items.name: xerj
items.description: AI search engine and MCP server for bots and agents. One Rust binary indexes code, docs, logs, JSONL/CSV and PDFs for BM25 full-text, vector and hybrid search, code search without grep, agent memory and RAG. Elasticsearch-compatible API; Corpus Hub serves hundreds of reference memory corpora.

readme.excerpt:
XERJ Query-1 · Blog post · Release rc.101 · llms.txt · Docs · Donate

Most AI search finds text in milliseconds and then asks a language model to write the answer. The model is what makes a RAG answer good, and it is also where the seconds and the per-question cost come from.

XERJ Query-1 works the other way. It reads your question and writes a short program (look this up, compare these, count those), and the engine runs that program over facts you stored. Lookup and comparison steps point at a stored fact and its quoted span; counts return a program hash, not the records. If the data cannot support an answer you get UNKNOWN ; if two facts disagree you get CONFLICT . It runs on four CPU cores, offline, with no embeddings to build and no GPU.

items.description: Run real Linux kernel natively on iOS

readme.excerpt:
Run a real Linux kernel natively on iOS, through the magic of User-mode Linux.

An Android emulator app built on the Kernarium runtime is available for download in App Store. Source code is available under Andarium/ .

If you want, you can also sideload IPA from releases.
features: Mainline 6.18 LTS kernel for both Linux and Android guests
Supports most kernel features, including namespaces, SELinux and more
CPU emulation

GPU acceleration
